mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_item WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT FROM sys_dict_item
ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT FROM sys_dict_item

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_item (id, tenant_id, dict_type_id, dict_label, dict_value, value_type, css_class, icon, list_class, is_default, sort_no, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{dictTypeId}, #{dictLabel}, #{dictValue}, #{valueType}, #{cssClass}, #{icon}, #{listClass}, #{isDefault}, #{sortNo}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_item SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.tenant_id, i.dict_type_id, i.dict_label, i.dict_value, i.value_type, i.css_class, i.icon, i.list_class, i.is_default, i.sort_no, i.status, i.remark, i.created_by, i.created_at, i.updated_by, i.updated_at, i.deleted FROM sys_dict_item i INNER JOIN sys_dict_type t ON i.dict_type_id = t.id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = '0' WHERE t.dict_type = #{dictType} AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = '0' AND (i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR i.tenant_id = '0') AND (t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR t.tenant_id = '0') ORDER BY i.sort_no ASC, i.created_at ASC
